title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 5.03 (versions follow prime numbers; 503 after 499): chained listening. Version 4.99 hung with her real ways (ways hold ways, and with no step ending the walk the same steps came round without end): now each step speaks once for an answer. And each proposal is heard as it comes: one that says a word an earlier one says links and her way goes on; the first that links with none adds nothing, her way is cut there and what she keeps is woven into her sentence (an anytime algorithm, Dean and Boddy 1988, cut where new answers stop adding). Measured on four phrases in a hidden copy with her real ways: from 55-76 seconds to 2-10 seconds an answer. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.03: escucha encadenada. Prototipo de investigación.
